chunks: And Husayn ibn Ibrahim narrated to me from Ibn Nuh from Abu Nasr Hibatullah ibn Muhammad who said: My uncle Abu Ibrahim Ja'far ibn Ahmad al-Nubakhti narrated to me, saying: My father Ahmad ibn Ibrahim and my uncle Abu Ja'far Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim and a group of our people - meaning the Banu Nubakht - told me:

that when the condition of Abu Ja'far al-Umari worsened, a group of the prominent figures of the Shi'a gathered, among them Abu Ali ibn Hammam, Abu Abdillah ibn Muhammad al-Katib, Abu Abdillah al-Baqitani, Abu Sahl Ismail ibn Ali al-Nubakhti, Abu Abdillah ibn al-Wajna, and others from the prominent and senior figures. They entered upon Abu Ja'far (may Allah be pleased with him) and said to him: 'If an event occurs, who will take your place?'

He said to them: 'This is Abu al-Qasim Husayn ibn Ruh ibn Abi Bahr al-Nubakhti, the one who stands in my place, the emissary between you and the Master of the Affair (peace be upon him), his agent and the trustworthy, reliable one. So refer to him in your affairs and rely upon him in your vital matters. I have been ordered to this and I have conveyed the message.'

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الْعُمَرِيُّ: Abu Ja'far al-Umari (a key figure in the transition)
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ مَقَامِي: The one standing in my place
key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْأَمْرِ: The Master of the Affair (Imam al-Mahdi)

ai.seo_question: Who did Abu Ja'far al-Umari designate as the successor and emissary to the Imam during the Occultation?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the pivotal moment when Abu Ja'far al-Umari, a key figure in the Minor Occultation, designated Abu al-Qasim Husayn ibn Ruh as his successor. The narrative underscores the institutionalization of the *Safir* (Emissary) role, establishing a trusted link between the Shia community and the Hidden Imam. This transition reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of maintaining continuity in religious authority through appointed deputies during the Imam's absence.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 342 - Husain Ibn Ibrahim narrated to me from Ibn Nuh from Abu Nasr Hibtullah bin Muhammad that: Narrated to me my uncle, Abu Ja’far Abdullah Ibn Ibrahim and others that

when the condition of Abu Ja’far Amari worsened, he gathered some personages of the Shia. There was Abu Ali Ibn Himam, Abu Abdullah Ibn Muhammad Katib, Abu Abdullah Baqitani, Abu Sahl Ismail Ibn Ali Naubakhti, Abu Abdullah Ibn Wajna and other senior individuals of the denomination. They came to Abu Ja’far and said: “If something happens, who will take your place?”

He said, ‘This, Abul Qasim Husain Ibn Rauh Ibn Abi Ja’far Naubakhti will take my place and will be the emissary between you and the Master of the Affair. He will be his representative and he is a reliable and honest man. Refer to him in your affairs and trust him in your vital matters. I have been ordered to that and I conveyed the message.”
